families._definition: completely prepared or in condition for immediate action or use or progress

members.tone: The plain word - preparation finished, with nothing left to do before starting.
members._gloss: completely prepared or in condition for immediate action or use or progress

members.tone: Held poised for the moment it is wanted, which puts the weight on the waiting rather than the preparing.
Inclination rather than preparation - the disposition is there, and nothing has been made ready.
members._gloss: (usually followed by ‘to’ or ‘for’) on the point of or strongly disposed

members.tone: Someone did the preparing, and did it deliberately - the readiness was loaded in.
members._gloss: (usually followed by ‘to’ or ‘for’) on the point of or strongly disposed

members.tone: Flat and final; the arrangement is fixed and all that remains is the signal.
members._gloss: (usually followed by ‘to’ or ‘for’) on the point of or strongly disposed

members.tone: Readiness as tidiness - each thing in its place, measured against a standard of proper arrangement.
members._gloss: in a state of proper readiness or preparation or arrangement

members.tone: Praise for the speed of the response and for the willingness behind it.
members._gloss: ready and willing or quick to act

members.tone: Readiness arrived at by itself rather than assembled, and it brings eagerness with it.
Patient and unexcited - it stresses that the readiness persists, not that it is keen.
members._gloss: being and remaining ready and available for use

members.tone: The doubled phrase makes a small boast of it: not merely available but conspicuously so.
members._gloss: being and remaining ready and available for use

members.tone: Measured and impersonal - it faults the result without accusing anyone of carelessness.
A call, not a judgement; it locates the pitch and implies nothing about the pitcher.
members._gloss: (of a baseball pitch) on the far side of home plate from the batter

members.tone: Purely positional, and plainer than *away* for saying where the pitch went.
members._gloss: (of a baseball pitch) on the far side of home plate from the batter

members.tone: Puts the error in the thing itself, as a defect it carries rather than a slip it made.
members._gloss: characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules

members.tone: The cool formal verdict - it marks the failure against the rule and stops there.
members._gloss: characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules

members.tone: Blunt and total; where *incorrect* grades a performance, this simply refuses it.
members._gloss: characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules

members.tone: A failure of trust rather than of aim - what it names has let someone down.
The miss is measured as distance, and the word says nothing about how bad it was.
The full phrase makes the miss vivid, and can carry a note of mild ridicule that *wide* alone does not.
Solidity all the way through - it says the finances would survive inspection.
Financial safety framed as something others can rely on rather than something merely held.
The mildest way to say the money is safe; it reassures without describing anything.
Concerned with what cannot be lost rather than with what might be gained.
Safety that has been arranged and held in place, not simply enjoyed.
Adds working order to safety: the money is not merely intact, it is doing its job.
Unglamorous, weighty approval - it promises holding rather than growth.
Praise for the absence of movement; what recommends it is that it does not swing.
members._gloss: firm and dependable; subject to little fluctuation

families._definition: conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy

members.tone: The plain standard - conformity to the fact or the model, claimed without drama.
members._gloss: conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total acc

members.tone: Fidelity with the gap admitted: it stays near the original rather than claiming to match it.
members._gloss: marked by fidelity to an original

members.tone: Fidelity treated as a kind of loyalty, as though the original were owed something.
members._gloss: marked by fidelity to an original

members.tone: Emphatic and informal; the admiration is for the aim as much as for the truth.
A technical grade rather than praise - it states how little the sound was altered.
members._gloss: characterized by minimal distortion in sound reproduction

members.tone: The clipped form, and friendlier than *high-fidelity* for making the same claim.
members._gloss: characterized by minimal distortion in sound reproduction

members.tone: Precision imagined as controlled and deliberate, cutting where intended and nowhere else.
Accuracy as honesty - nothing bent to suit anyone.
The flight went where it was aimed; the praise is for the aim, not for the truth of a statement.
Leaves no margin at all, and says so with some satisfaction.
Formal and exacting, treating precision as a virtue worth a long word.
The everyday word; it settles the matter without dwelling on how exact the exactness is.

families.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

members.tone: Approval with the surprise kept in - the good turn was neither earned nor expected.
Comparative by construction - it always implies something being compared against, and never says what.
members._gloss: in a more fortunate or prosperous condition

members.tone: Formal and pleased, treating the good fortune as elegant rather than merely welcome.
Good fortune, not gladness - the luck sits in the outcome rather than in anyone's feelings.
Insists on the chance: the good outcome arrived unsteered.
The barest approval available - the result went the right way, and nothing more is claimed.
Approval of how a thing turned out, judged by the ending rather than by the doing.
Gratitude pitched high - the timing was so apt it invites the comparison the gloss makes.
members._gloss: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention

members.tone: The graver word for that aptness, and it treats the rescue as intended rather than lucky.
members._gloss: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention

members.tone: The strongest of the three: it does not merely note the aptness, it marvels at it.
members._gloss: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention

members.tone: Plain and cheerful; it credits the chance and takes nothing away from the person.
Fortune as a position someone occupies rather than an event that befell them.

families._definition: (superlative of ‘good’) having the most positive qualities

members.tone: The superlative itself - it closes the comparison rather than making one.
members._gloss: (superlative of ‘good’) having the most positive qualities

members.tone: First place won against others; the contest comes with the praise.
members._gloss: holding first place in a contest

members.tone: The same first place, evidenced - it points at the award rather than at the quality.
members._gloss: holding first place in a contest

members.tone: Quality stated as a classification, the way a supplier states it.
The plainest strong claim about quality, with nothing held back and nothing specified.
Grading language again, pushed to the top of the scale rather than merely high on it.
Rank asserted flatly; it orders things and leaves the reason unsaid.
Formal and a little ceremonious - it places something ahead as a matter of standing.
Sets the comparison as wide as it will go, which is the whole of the compliment.

members._skip_reason: gloss is a usage restriction, not a definition

members.tone: Best within limits - it carries the constraint it is best under wherever it goes.
members._gloss: most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied

members.tone: The same bounded best, worn as an adjective of analysis rather than of praise.
members._gloss: most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied

members.tone: Slangy and enthusiastic; the enthusiasm is the point, not the grading.
Best measured against history rather than against rivals present.
Praise with the loss inside it - a high place named together with the fact of not holding the highest.
A grading word for goods, pitched a step above *fine* and doing its work by the pitch alone.
members._gloss: (used especially of merchandise) very fine in quality

families._definition: of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis

members.tone: Importance at its sharpest - something turns on this, and the turning is what the word insists on.
members._gloss: of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis

members.tone: The broad word for weight, pressed here into service at crisis strength.
members._gloss: of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis

members.tone: Names the turning point and the danger in it at once; the word is tense.
members._gloss: forming or having the nature of a turning point or crisis

members.tone: The same turning point read from the other side - what settles the matter rather than what threatens it.
members._gloss: forming or having the nature of a turning point or crisis

members.tone: The stakes stated as plainly as they can be, which is where the phrase gets its force.
The same stakes with the alternatives set against each other, which sharpens the choice.
Importance defined by what swings on it: everything else moves around this one point.
A fixed point that others take their bearings from, rather than one events turn on.
The plain word - trust earned by behaving the same way every time.
Warmer than *reliable*: it suggests someone is doing the depending.
Reliability stated as an outcome - it will work, and the working is not in doubt.
The same confidence, shorter and more casual, and readier to be said out loud.
Trust backed by having been put through something rather than merely assumed.
members._gloss: tested and proved to be reliable

members.tone: The testing was long as well as real, and the length is the recommendation.
members._gloss: tested and proved to be reliable

members.tone: Quiet approval; it says only that the thing has been used and did not fail.
members._gloss: tested and proved to be reliable

members.tone: The pairing does the work - the testing and the verdict in one breath, with some fondness.
members._gloss: tested and proved to be reliable

members.tone: Steadiness treated as a virtue of principle, praising what refuses to bend.
members._gloss: used of values and principles; not subject to change; steady

families._definition: kept intact or in a particular condition

members.tone: Deliberate keeping - the condition held on purpose rather than by luck.
members._gloss: kept intact or in a particular condition

members.tone: Keeping framed as husbandry: what matters is that nothing was spent or lost.
Ongoing effort, plainly said - the condition is the result of continued work.
The formal word for that same effort, crediting the routine rather than the care.
Approving of the result, and of whoever is answerable for it.
A statement of possibility rather than of condition; nothing has been kept yet.
Safety supplied from outside - the word implies a guard as much as a state.
Rescue rather than upkeep: it implies the loss came close and did not happen.
Cool and possessive; it says something was not let go, without praising the holding.
members._gloss: continued in your keeping or use or memory
